$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}9p-3q &=-7 \\ 5p-q &=-4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

$$

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}9 & -3 & -7 \\ 5 & -1 & -4\end{array}\right]
$$
